display_long_description:
📻 Radio Stream - Your Gateway to Global Radio

Discover and enjoy thousands of radio stations from around the world, all in one beautiful app. Radio Stream automatically finds stations near your location the first time you open it, giving you an instant personalized listening experience.

🌍 GLOBAL RADIO COVERAGE
- Access radio stations from over 200 countries
- Search by station name or filter by country
- Discover local and international music, news, talk shows, and more

🎵 SMART FEATURES
- Auto-detect your location for personalized station recommendations
- History of recently played stations for quick access
- Add your favorite stations to easily find them later
- Smooth background playback with lock screen controls

🌐 MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT
- Available in 22 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Hindi, Italian, Turkish, Dutch, Polish, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish, Greek, Czech, Ukrainian, and Indonesian
- Auto-detects your country and sets the language accordingly

🎨 ELEGANT DESIGN
- Clean, modern Spotify-inspired dark theme
- Easy-to-use interface
- Optimized for smooth performance

📻 HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the app - we'll automatically find stations near you
2. Tap any station to start listening
3. Use the Search tab to discover more stations worldwide
4. Save your favorites for quick access

🔊 PERFECT FOR
- Music lovers who want to explore global sounds
- News enthusiasts staying updated from aro
